| description =
Kindle or his PH spawns at #2 close to the three steps leading to #1 on the map. This room has sparkling red walls, and an invisible pit in the center that falls down to efreeti room. Upon spawning he stays still for a moment then either bolts South or West, wanders for a minute or two then backtracks all the way to his spawn point.

It's best to stay in the hallway between #1 and #2 on the map, as Kindle and his PH (random fire goblin) are the only mobs that path through there. 

''Caution: At the other end of the hallway, there are two rooms with two and three goblins. Be careful you're not too close, or some will social aggro if the roamer aggroes too close to them. The hallway corner is safer but you also risk aggroing the two goblins on the left in the efreeti pit room where he spawns so either lull in advance or keep those two goblins down. He's not worth chasing as he paths through a dozen goblins either way he runs off. Just be patient, he'll be back.''


06-14-2024: Did 90 cycles, got 8 Kindle and 8 rings. I'm either very unlucky or the gloves are quite rare. 10% spawn chance sounds about right.
